fact: The first live government-to-person grant payments went through Namibia's instant payment network on 17 June 2026, to beneficiaries in the Marginalised Beneficiaries grant category, via Bank Windhoek, in a controlled go-live.
system: Government grant payments over the instant payment network (Marginalised Beneficiaries grant)

fact: The fact sheet says Instant Payment Solution pilot testing finished in live production and a phased rollout is underway, with phase 1 having participating institutions receive and disburse government social grant payments through the platform.
system: Government social grant payments on the Instant Payment Solution (IPS)

fact: The finance and gender ministries confirmed in a joint notice that 15,825 old-age grants were suspended because beneficiary names were unverified in the National Population Registry System, so the grant beneficiary list is checked against the population registry.
A gender ministry spokesperson said the ministry is planning to incorporate its system with that of the Ministry of Home Affairs for improved reporting of deaths.

The Ministry's activity page lists MoUs for data integration with GIPF, SSC, the tax system, IFMS and the Veteran Affairs System, and the integration of the ISAS module into the Integrated Beneficiary Registry, and gives the activity as Complete with the system piloted by June 2022.
The page says a central information management system was developed holding all social grant beneficiaries, to remove duplication, with the activity at 100 percent and Complete.

The policy, adopted by Cabinet in March 2021, lists unintegrated management information systems and fragmentation among current social protection challenges and says there is no integrated management information system for social protection.
system: Social protection programme management information systems

fact: Namibia's instant payment network, operated by Instant Payments Namibia (a Bank of Namibia subsidiary), processed its first live government grant payments, with Bank Windhoek disbursing a batch to Marginalised Beneficiaries on 17 June 2026 and Letshego Bank Namibia certified to receive grant payments.
